values.value: Bryan Russell is a former member
Bryan Russell owns Sam's old franchise for 2027

conflicts.note: The rule book calls Bryan Russell a former member while the 2027 config has him running Sam's old team. Until the commissioner rules, his four runner-up finishes stay on his own franchise and are not counted for the current member.
conflicts.resolution: Combined. Bryan Russell is one member with one record: his own franchise resumed when he took the slot Sam left.
